title: General Immunohistochemical Protocol for Tissue Sections
author: Tereza Blassova
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7uxhnxn
materials: Drain off the blocking buffer from the slides.

steps.title: Deparaffinize slides
steps.instruction: Immerse each slide in three successive changes of xylene, 5 minutes per change.

steps.title: Block endogenous peroxidase
steps.instruction: Incubate sections in Dako Peroxidase‑Blocking solution at room temperature for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Rinse in PBS (first)
steps.instruction: Rinse slides in 300 mL phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS) for three changes, 5 minutes each.

steps.title: Antigen retrieval (optional)
steps.instruction: Perform one of the following antigen‑retrieval methods as needed:

substeps.instruction: Arrange slides in a staining container, add 300 mL of 10 mM citrate buffer (pH 6.0), heat to 95‑100 °C for 10 minutes, then allow to cool at room temperature for 20 minutes.
Heat‑induced epitope retrieval using Epitope Retrieval Solution (Novocastra Leica) at pH 9 or pH 6 for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Rinse in PBS (second)
steps.instruction: Rinse slides again in 300 mL PBS for three changes, 5 minutes each.

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding (optional)
steps.instruction: Apply 200 µL of blocking buffer (e.g., 10 % goat serum in PBS) to each section and incubate in a humidified chamber at room temperature for 1 hour.

steps.title: Incubate primary antibody
steps.instruction: Apply 200 µL of appropriately diluted primary antibody (in antibody dilution buffer) to each section and incubate in a humidified chamber at room temperature overnight (≈16 hours) or at 4 °C.

steps.title: Apply secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of appropriately diluted secondary antibody (in antibody dilution buffer) to each section and incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Apply two drops of N‑Histofine® Simple Stain MAX PO (MULTI) to fully cover the sections.
Incubate the slides at room temperature for an additional 30 minutes.

steps.title: Wash in PBS (post‑secondary)
steps.instruction: Wash slides in 300 mL PBS for three changes, 5 minutes each.

steps.title: Develop with DAB
steps.instruction: Apply 150 µL of DAB Liquid solution (Dako) to each section and allow color development for less than 5 minutes, stopping when the desired intensity is reached. (Handle DAB as a suspected carcinogen; wear gloves, lab coat, and eye protection.)

steps.title: Rinse in distilled water
steps.instruction: Rinse slides in distilled water for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Counterstain with hematoxylin (optional)
steps.instruction: Immerse the slide sides in Gill’s Hematoxylin for 1–2 minutes.

steps.title: Rinse in tap water
steps.instruction: Rinse slides in running tap water for more than 15 minutes.

steps.title: Clear and mount slides
steps.instruction: Clear the tissue sections through three changes of xylene, then apply mounting solution and place a coverslip; store the mounted slides at room temperature permanently.

steps.title: Observe staining
steps.instruction: Examine the antibody staining under a microscope and record the results.

steps.title: Wash in PBS (additional)
steps.instruction: Wash the slides in 300 mL PBS for three changes, 5 minutes each.
